end.summary: Practised expanding base-10 numbers using place value and powers of 10, including zero as a placeholder.
end.parentNote: Neel practised reading place-value boxes and converting between base 10 and base 2. They correctly identified 32 + 8 + 4 + 1 for 45 and later gave 11 for 1011; the mix-up that base 10 is the only valid number system was corrected during the lesson, though teach-back was not completed. At home, use small boxes labelled 8, 4, 2, 1 and ask Neel to mark 0 or 1, then add the selected values.
